summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 3 requested changes on preview URL. Login with owner account (sun@sohighon.ai / SunAdmin@2026) works and redirects to /portal. Portal Dashboard renders the new recharts demo analytics (Live badge, 6 gradient KPI tiles, area+line visibility chart, leads/booked bar chart, leads-by-service pie, goal-progress radial gauge) with no runtime/page errors; 'Jump into a service' cards still render below. Portal Leads: 'Demo data' toggle is CHECKED BY DEFAULT, demo note visible, 12 non-spam demo rows in leads-table, stat tiles populate (13/4/3), status change + notes edit update the row locally and fire a 'Lead updated' toast, unchecking shows leads-empty (0 stats), re-checking restores demo rows and preserves the edited status. Marketing homepage: stack-calculator / stack-heading / 'The stack you'd otherwise need' are fully removed while the WhyUs comparison table is still present. Only cosmetic issues found.

issues: Legend (layout=vertical, align=right, verticalAlign=middle) is drawn ON TOP of the radial rings - label text overlaps the magenta ring and the first characters ('Q3 pipeline goal', 'SoV target', 'Content published') are clipped/unreadable. Fix by giving the legend its own space (e.g. RadialBarChart cx="40%" or legend wrapperStyle right offset / place legend below).
Legend colour swatch order does not match the rings/values it labels (recharts renders RadialBar cells in reverse order), so 'Q3 pipeline goal' shows a magenta swatch while its fill is green.

Minor data inconsistency: leads-stat-total shows 13 (includes the hidden spam demo lead demo-13) while the table renders 12 rows because spam is filtered out. Consider computing stats over non-spam leads (or over the filtered set) for consistency.

action_items: Fix radial gauge legend overlap/clipping in PortalDashboard.jsx chart-gauges (cosmetic, HIGH visual impact)
Align gauge legend swatch colours with the corresponding metric (or use custom legend content)
Optional: exclude spam demo lead from leads-stat-total so tile count matches the visible rows
critical_code_review_comments: PortalDashboard.jsx: a <Line> child inside <AreaChart> works today but is not the documented recharts pattern - prefer <ComposedChart> to avoid breakage on recharts upgrades.
PortalLeadsBoard.jsx: demo lead edits are only in React state (expected for mock mode) - they are lost on reload; acceptable per requirement but worth noting in UI copy.

PortalDashboard.jsx / PortalLeadsBoard.jsx build API base from window.location.origin instead of process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL - works behind the same-origin ingress but deviates from the env-var rule.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass (2 cosmetic issues)
